scoring_rules.Recall@k: Fraction of ground-truth document+page targets present in top k retrieved chunks.
scoring_rules.MRR: Reciprocal rank of first retrieved chunk matching ground-truth document+page.
scoring_rules.nDCG@10: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at rank 10 with binary relevance.
scoring_rules.Citation Precision: Fraction of returned verified citations that match ground-truth document+page.
scoring_rules.Abstention F1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for insufficient_evidence classification.
scoring_rules.Facts Coverage: Fraction of expected key facts and figures present in the synthesized answer.

known_limitations: Exact page matching allows a +/- 1 page window to accommodate boundary overlap across PDF pagination.
Abstention precision evaluates explicit 'insufficient_evidence: true' flag rather than free-form prose refusal.
Key facts coverage relies on token and entity matching; human review is recommended for semantic nuances.
